candidates.platform_title: Two Cells Look Equal but Don't Match? Try TRIM in Calc
candidates.factual_description: Two spreadsheet cells can look the same but compare FALSE because of a leading space. Watch a real LibreOffice Calc worksheet use TRIM to return TRUE. This demonstration uses fictional data and contains no personal information. Official help: https://help.libreoffice.org/
candidates.pinned_comment_draft: What real data problem should we demonstrate next: extra spaces, duplicates, or dates? Follow Real Data Fixes for short, practical demonstrations.
candidates.mobile_cover_brief: Choose a real recorded frame where the sheet's FALSE and TRUE comparison are readable; no invented before/after graphics.

candidates.platform_title: Find Errors Fast in a 780-Line Log (Chrome Ctrl+F)
candidates.factual_description: Use Chrome's native Find to locate ERROR in a long page and Ctrl+G to visit the next match. This original demo uses a fictional, local 780-line log containing 12 sample errors. No external website, personal account or user browser setting is involved. Official help: https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/95440
candidates.pinned_comment_draft: For a long log, would you rather search ERROR or scroll manually? More first-party, real-software data fixes are in this series.
candidates.mobile_cover_brief: Choose the genuine recorded Chrome Find bar showing ERROR and a highlighted fictional error line; no fabricated website screenshot.
